about: Which rules scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs enforces in this repo, the offender lists the tracked files are checked against, and the files the two cleanup scripts leave alone.
codemodSkipReason: Copies of client CMS files whose sha256 data/cms-feature-tree.meta.json records. Reword them in website-cms and copy them again with scripts/sync-cms-feature-tree.mjs.
scrubExcludeReason: Files another change set is rewriting. Their findings stay on the client-data offender list until that change set lands; then the scrub runs on them too.
